name: 2.5D Photometric Studio configures light direction, material shaders, and bakes tangent normal maps
description: Verify drawing a solid colored circular ball on canvas, navigating to PixiBud AI, switching between Auto and Manual modes, tweaking Direction and Elevation, testing Material chips, and baking tangent-space normal maps.

planSteps.description: Select the Ellipse tool (press O), ensure shape mode in context bar is 'Shape: Filled Solid', press down on canvas, drag diagonally for at least 150 pixels, and release to draw a prominent circle
Select the Flood Fill tool (press G), select an amber/gold color swatch, and click inside the circle to solidly fill it with color
Verify a solid colored circular ball is clearly visible on the canvas
Click the 'PixiBud AI' tab button in the right inspector panel
Verify the 2.5D Photometric Studio section is visible with Auto and Manual mode toggles
Verify a dedicated 'Photometric' layer is rendered over the ball with 3D cel-shading and specular shine
Click the 'Bake Normal Map' button in the photometric panel
Verify a dedicated 'Normal Map' layer is created containing encoded tangent-space normal vector colors (#8080FF baseline)
